about: One story, as the feed serves it and as the Android app sends it back. The Android unit test (ShareLinksTest) parses `served` with the app's own FeedParser and must produce exactly `body`; the web unit test (share.test.mjs) checks that the server signs `served` as `sig` and accepts `body` as that very story. If either side's canonical form drifts, one of the two fails. `secret` only exists to make the vector reproducible.
